creatures.name: Diseased Leech

archive.notes: Fish Basket capture is possible, but a captured leech is not a normal returning companion after attachment. The diseased variant can transmit Swamp Fever. Keep distance in swamp encounters and check both survivor and mount when removing an attached leech. Its higher blood drop is a variant difference; no exact amount is claimed.
